concept: A fractured, fragmented mirror or prism breaking apart into jagged shards, each shard reflecting a different chaotic scene—fire, weapons, prison bars, diplomatic ruptures, surveillance eyes—all simultaneously visible yet broken and disconnected. The shards scatter outward from a central void. Colors are cold and discordant. Style: digital, geometric, brutal abstraction with sharp edges and violent composition. High contrast, dystopian mood.
explanation: Today's news reads as a cascade of simultaneous crises: execution failures, geopolitical threats, diplomatic breakdowns, escalating violence in multiple regions, child safety failures, and authoritarian repression. Rather than depict any single narrative, the fragmented mirror reflects the fractured state of global order itself—multiple systems breaking down at once, each shard a different catastrophe, none fully visible from any single angle. The concept suggests a world coming apart along multiple fault lines simultaneously.

headlines.title: US pressures Europe over diesel reserves as Trump threatens export ban
headlines.summary: President Donald Trump has threatened to ban diesel exports in a bid to ease prices in the US ahead of the November elections.

headlines.title: Christa Pike in critical condition after surviving two lethal injections, lawyer says
headlines.summary: Pike’s lawyers have asked for her death sentence to be commuted following the botched execution.

headlines.title: NY's governor appoints special prosecutor in Cornell frat rape investigation

headlines.summary: President Lee Jae Myung also accused Kyiv of "attempting to provoke a war on the Korean Peninsula".

headlines.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
headlines.summary: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

headlines.title: OpenAI fires workers for mishandling 'sensitive information'

headlines.summary: The Russian leader insists Moscow is "not threatening anyone" and is merely responding to statements by Western leaders.
